title: 第30章 计划第31章 宴会
slug: 诡秘星轨交织的夜第222章
content_zh:
带着《诡秘之主》记忆穿越诡秘世界，是一种什么感受？
说实话，莫甘娜觉得并不是很好！
虽然父亲是非凡者，且在鲁恩的地位也不低，但是他似乎并不希望自己的女儿也走上非凡这条路，这件事本来是可以慢慢谋划的，可是，天生就定下来的途径，让莫甘娜崩溃了！
问，自己要怎么前往星空，在那位被污染的伯特利·亚伯拉罕处，得到序列1非凡特性乃至唯一性？
更何况，还有一个阿蒙在一边虎视眈眈！
第二，就是莫名出现的系统，虽然系统可能是穿越者的标配，但是有安提哥努斯容纳唯一性的方法在前面，莫甘娜能信任吗？
说不定现在的一切都是假的呢！
任何有思维的东西都不可以轻易信任，就算是系统，也不可以！
现在基本上是死局，莫甘娜只能慢慢盘活其中的棋子，寻找那一线生机，最好是获得一位真神的支持，还得是那种没有什么恶意的真神才行。
克莱恩，就是莫甘娜定下的目标，将来的诡秘之主，虽然自己没有成神的机会，但是现在自己这样不也没有吗？
还不如成为愚者先生的眷者，慢慢成为序列2的天使，也很不错呀。
只不过，莫甘娜还是不甘心的，将来为什么那么多神都跑出来，不就是因为末日即将到来吗？
真到了那个时候，天使又怎么样，能活下来吗？
要有点想法，既然选择争了，就要争得彻底，拿个真神当当，“门”谋划不了的话，“黑皇帝”这个万能的也可以嘛。
“莫甘娜、莫甘娜，你觉得怎么样？”
奥莱尔的呼喊叫醒了正在思考的莫甘娜，并没有听全的莫甘娜为了不引起异常，只顺从的应下奥莱尔的话，没有叫奥莱尔看出自己面上的不对劲。
“你既然答应了，那就先从廷根开始吧，德维尔爵士，你应该知道，他是廷根的富商，过段时间，就是他的生日，莫甘娜，你需要好好准备一下。”
“我知道了，父亲。”
女儿的懂事让奥莱尔很是满意，简单的说了一下廷根的局势，奥莱尔就放莫甘娜回去了。
“宿主？”系统的声音突兀的响起，让莫甘娜不得不打起精神应付。

“怎么了？”莫甘娜敛去之前只知道和系统对着干的气势，难得的有些温和。
“你看着不是很愿意？”
莫甘娜知道系统在询问什么，只不过，“你怎么就知道我不愿意？”
虽然，这些年在明里暗里的试探中，推测出系统应该是不知道自己在想些什么，但是，莫甘娜还是不放心，一个能够思考的生物，存在于自己的脑海里面，让心里秘密很多的莫甘娜自然升起警惕。
“看表情呀，”系统像是没有听出莫甘娜语气中的试探，只将自己看到的全部说出，“你不愿意，所以多余的话都不愿意说，只会低着头表示自己的抗拒，不过，他和相处那么久，肯定知道这个你这个习惯，为什么……”
莫甘娜眼神冷厉下来，会思考果然不好呀，这么多年了，心还不是偏向自己的，还在谋算这本不该的谋算。
“是呀，父亲肯定知道的，但是，他这么做都是为了我好。”莫甘娜的语气难掩失落，话却是偏向自己的父亲。
天尊暗自叹气，之前的决定还是太草率了，因为自己无法让莫甘娜走向自己需要的路，就选择了奥莱尔，让他成为莫甘娜的领路人，现在想要隔绝掉奥莱尔和莫甘娜的关系还是有点难。
没关系，总有机会的，况且，自己还有奥莱尔最大的把柄在手上，最后，莫甘娜信任的只会是他一个。
暗搓搓挑拨完父女关系的天尊知道什么是适可而止，转而询问起莫甘娜任务的事情。
提起任务，莫甘娜也顾不上心里的那点小失落了，“我知道了，还有很长时间，我不会给你机会的。”
为了之后的计划，她也该慢慢停下这没有意义的任务了。
莫甘娜坐在桌前，握紧笔，一笔一笔书写着，墨迹在纸上缓缓晕开。
平静的日子过了一周，这段时间，莫甘娜就连在塔罗会上也是安安静静的，践行着父亲的对自己的祝愿，不过多接触非凡世界。
这天，奥莱尔就收到了德维尔爵士的请帖，邀他以及莫甘娜一起参加他的晚宴，父女两个坐着马车前往晚宴。
马车上，奥莱尔嘱咐道，“听说，他前段时间因为某些事情身体不是很好，那段时间可是有不少人不安分，所以这次的晚宴，也算是他的一次警告，莫甘娜，我想你会挑选合适人的交往的。”
奥莱尔说着，严肃的语气也装不下去了，看着莫甘娜笑了出来，“好吧，你可以忘记我前面说的话，虽然家族大部分都是商业，但是以维斯珀的地位，他们不也不敢有什么不满，你就是单纯的去玩而已，只要别惹出太大麻烦，德维尔那边都不会怎么样的。”
“您和德维尔爵士很熟悉？”莫甘娜敏感的捕捉到了奥莱尔话语中的熟稔，虽然这人只是出现的很少，但是他的思想，可是莫甘娜需要的，要是父亲与德维尔熟识，莫甘娜也能趁机接近，在不引起怀疑的时候改变自己的性格，一位温婉优雅的贵族小姐可不能完成她之后的计划。
奥莱尔想了想，谨慎的回答女儿的问题，“并不是很熟悉，只不过是有部分产业有合作，他是个聪明人，在我表示了，你是我未来的继承人之后，他会很友好的，只是和不重要的人交往，对他来说不是值得记挂的事情。”
很快，马车就到达了宴会地点。

一切都很是奢华，德维尔爵士宴会厅里，烛光在水晶吊灯间闪烁，空气里飘着香槟和烤肉的香味，绅士们的笑声和女士们的闲聊混合在一起，听起来挺热闹的。
莫甘娜站在父亲奥莱尔身侧，象牙白绸缎长裙显得整个人格外的圣洁。
莫甘娜垂着眼，带着笑，听着父亲与其他人的交谈，时不时打声招呼。
“德维尔，”奥莱尔声音洪亮，很明显，这些话并不是说给德维尔一个人听的，“先让我庆祝你，之后，容我向你介绍我的女儿，莫甘娜。”
content_en:
What is it like to travel through the mysterious world with the memory of "Lord of Mysteries"?
To be honest, Morgana didn't think it was very good!
Although his father is an Extraordinary and his status in Loen is not low, he does not seem to want his daughter to follow the path of Extraordinary. This matter could have been planned slowly, but the path that was determined by birth made Morgana collapse!
Ask, how can I go to the starry sky and obtain the extraordinary characteristics and even uniqueness of Sequence 1 from the polluted Bethel Abraham?
What's more, there is Amon watching eagerly from the side!
Second, there is the system that appears inexplicably. Although the system may be a standard feature for time travellers, with Antigonus’ method of accommodating uniqueness in front of him, can Morgana trust it?
Maybe everything is fake now!
No thinking thing can be easily trusted, not even the system!
Now it is basically a dead end. Morgana can only slowly reorganize the pieces in it and look for a glimmer of hope. It is best to get the support of a true god, and it must be the kind of true god who has no malicious intentions.
Klein is Morgana's goal, the future Lord of Mysteries. Although he has no chance of becoming a god, doesn't he have no chance of becoming a god now?
It's better to become Mr. Fool's favored one and slowly become a Sequence 2 angel, which is also very good.
However, Morgana is still unwilling to give in. Why are so many gods running out in the future? Isn't it because the end is coming?
When that time comes, what will happen to the angels? Will they survive?
You have to have some ideas. Since you have chosen to fight, you must fight thoroughly and treat yourself as a true god. If the "Sect" cannot plan, the almighty "Black Emperor" can also do it.
"Morgana, Morgana, what do you think?"
Aurel's shout woke up Morgana who was thinking. Morgana, who didn't listen fully, in order not to cause any abnormalities, only obeyed Aurel's words obediently and did not let Aurel see anything wrong with her face.
"Since you agreed, let's start with Tingen first. Sir De Vere, you should know that he is a wealthy businessman from Tingen. It will be his birthday in a while. Morgana, you need to prepare well."
"I understand, Father."
Orel was very satisfied with his daughter's understanding. After briefly talking about the situation in Tingen, Orel let Morgana go back.
"Host?" The system's voice suddenly sounded, forcing Morgana to brace herself.
"What's wrong?" Morgana calmed down the momentum that she had only known to confront the system before, and she was rare and gentle.
"You don't seem very willing?"
Morgana knew what the system was asking, but, "How do you know I don't want to?"
Although, through overt and covert testing over the years, it was deduced that the system did not know what she was thinking, Morgana still felt uneasy. A creature capable of thinking existed in her mind, which made Morgana, who had many secrets in her heart, naturally become wary.
"Look at your expression," the system seemed not to hear the temptation in Morgana's tone, and just said everything it saw, "You don't want to, so you don't want to say anything extra. You just lower your head to show your resistance. However, he has been with you for so long, so he must know this habit of yours, and why..."
Morgana's eyes became cold and stern, it was really not good to be able to think. After so many years, her heart was still not biased towards her, and she was still making plans that she shouldn't have.
"Yes, my father must know, but he did this for my own good." Morgana's tone could not conceal her disappointment, but her words were biased towards her father.
Tianzun sighed secretly. His previous decision was still too hasty. Because he couldn't let Morgana go the way she needed, he chose Aurel and made him become Morgana's leader. Now he wants toIt's still a bit difficult to isolate the relationship between Aurel and Morgana.
It doesn't matter, there is always a chance. Besides, he still has Aurel's biggest handle. In the end, Morgana will only trust him.
After secretly instigating the relationship between father and daughter, Tianzun knew when enough was enough, and turned to ask about Morgana's mission.
When the task was mentioned, Morgana couldn't care less about the little disappointment in her heart, "I know, it will still be a long time, and I won't give you a chance."
For the sake of future plans, it was time for her to slowly stop this meaningless task.
Morgana sat at the table, holding the pen tightly, writing stroke by stroke, the ink slowly spreading on the paper.
A week of peaceful days passed. During this period, Morgana was quiet even in the Tarot meeting, fulfilling her father's wishes for herself, but not having too much contact with the extraordinary world.
On this day, Aurel received an invitation from Sir De Vere, inviting him and Morgana to attend his dinner party. The father and daughter went to the dinner party in a carriage.
On the carriage, Aurel ordered, "I heard that he was not in good health due to some things some time ago. During that time, many people were restless, so this dinner can be regarded as a warning from him. Morgana, I think you will choose the right person to associate with."
Aurel said, he could no longer pretend to be serious and looked at Morgana and laughed, "Okay, you can forget what I said before. Although most of the family is in business, with Vesper's status, they don't dare to have any dissatisfaction. You are just going to have fun. As long as you don't cause too much trouble, nothing will happen to Deville."
"Are you familiar with Sir De Vere?" Morgana sensitively captured the familiarity in Aurel's words. Although this person only appeared rarely, his thoughts were what Morgana needed. If her father was familiar with De Vere, Morgana could also take the opportunity to get close and change her personality without arousing suspicion. A gentle and elegant noble lady could not complete her subsequent plans.
Olaier thought for a while and answered his daughter's question cautiously, "I'm not very familiar with you. It's just that we have cooperation in some industries. He is a smart man. After I said that you are my future heir, he will be very friendly. But interacting with unimportant people is not something worth remembering for him."
Soon, the carriage arrived at the banquet location.
Everything was very luxurious. In Sir De Vere's banquet hall, candlelight flickered between the crystal chandeliers, the scent of champagne and barbecue floated in the air, and the laughter of the gentlemen and the chatter of the ladies were mixed together, which sounded lively.
Morgana stood beside her father Aurel, wearing an ivory white satin dress that made her look particularly holy.
Morgana lowered her eyes and smiled, listening to her father's conversation with other people, saying hello from time to time.
"Deville," Aurel's voice was loud, and it was obvious that these words were not meant for Deville alone, "let me celebrate you first, and then, let me introduce my daughter, Morgana, to you."
